story.title: The Pain Broker
story.logline: A man sells his physical pain to desperate strangers, until he buys back the worst agony imaginable.
story.theme: The true cost of escaping suffering
story.twist: The agony he purchased belonged to his future self, sent back in time.
story.ending: Would you buy your tomorrow to survive today?

scenes.narration: Want to buy a migraine? Just five dollars, perfectly fresh and ready for your nervous system.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 25, dark messy hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, inside a dimly lit neon-soaked pawnshop.

scenes.narration: I extract my own physical agony and bottle it, selling every sharp stab to people who prefer my pain to theirs.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, holding a glowing glass vial in the cramped pawnshop.

scenes.narration: Business is booming because everyone wants an easy life, leaving me broke, broken, but completely pain-free.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, looking at a cash register filled with crumpled bills in the pawnshop.

scenes.narration: Then an old man walks in, placing a heavy, pitch-black jar onto my dusty glass counter.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, staring at a terrifying dark glass jar in the dim pawnshop.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo's shocked face

scenes.narration: He whispers that it holds the ultimate agony, a localized heart-stopping torture worth a thousand normal lifetimes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, leaning over the counter in the gloomy pawnshop, eyes wide.

scenes.narration: Curiosity wins. I pay him my entire life savings just to taste what true suffering feels like.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, shoving stacks of cash across the counter in the pawnshop.

scenes.narration: I open the lid, and the invisible terror rushes straight into my chest, shattering every breath.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, grasping his chest in agony inside the dim pawnshop.

scenes.narration: As my vision fades, I look in the dusty mirror and finally recognize the old man's face.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, collapsing and staring into a cracked mirror in the pawnshop.

scenes.narration: It was me. Older, scarred, sending my worst nightmare back through time just to survive another day.
scenes.visual_prompt: Reflection of an older, battered version of Leo in the broken mirror, fading away in the pawnshop.

scenes.narration: Want to buy a migraine? Just five dollars, perfectly fresh and ready for your nervous system.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, dark messy hair, gray hoodie, standing alone in the dark neon pawnshop holding a glowing vial.

caption.hook: He sold his pain. Then he bought it back.
caption.title: The Pain Broker
caption.caption:
In a world where agony can be traded like currency, one man makes a living absorbing the trauma of strangers. But every transaction has a price, and his final purchase is a haunting echo of tomorrow.

Would you bear your worst suffering twice if it meant saving someone today?
